WHY WE ARE BUILDING STORY COMPASS

A little less searching.
A lot more listening.

A personal discovery companion for Bengali audio stories on YouTube.

Explore stories →

THE PROBLEM

Finding your next story takes too long.

Listeners often repeat searches, revisit familiar channels and try several videos before finding an audio story that fits their taste and available time.

OUR VISION

Help every listener find a story worth their time.

Starting with Bengali audio stories, Story Compass brings stories together around language, genre, author, series and listening preferences, helping people discover creators and stories they might otherwise miss.

WHAT MAKES IT PERSONAL

Your taste, with room to explore.

Browse by genre and verified duration. Use the heart to like a story, thumbs down to hide one, and Already heard to distinguish familiar stories from discovery candidates. More like this finds stories with similar genres.

Searches and history entries indicate exploration, not confirmed enjoyment. A video missing from an export may still be a story you have heard.

RECOMMENDATIONS & PRIVACY

A prototype we can improve together.

The base ranking uses story attributes and feedback. The local research pipeline can supply semantic similarity and LLM reranking scores when those optional outputs are prepared. Their benefit still needs evaluation against actual listener choices.

Feedback is stored in your browser. Personal YouTube exports and derived history data stay outside the public website and GitHub catalog. Public catalog entries contain story metadata; listening takes place on YouTube.

FUTURE PLANS

Keep discovery accessible.

Possible ways to sustain the project include optional premium discovery tools, clearly labeled editorial sponsorships, disclosed affiliate partnerships and creator services. These are plans, not currently available paid features. Payment will not buy organic recommendation positions.
